title: 第3章 脱险

content_zh:
嗯，叫“大叔”应该能让人家放心了吧？
自以为体贴的乔昭语速飞快，说起事情的来龙去脉：“我是京城黎修撰之女，花朝节上被人贩子拐到这里来，求大叔救救我——”
大叔……
这两个字让池灿嘴角直抽，噗嗤几声笑传来，不用想就知道是两位好友，更是让他想伸手堵住这小姑娘的嘴。
他明明比这小姑娘大不了几岁，怎么就成大叔了？叫大哥才对！
不过……若是光天化日之下冲出个姑娘叫他大哥，他恐怕第一反应就是把人甩开吧？
思及此处，池灿眸光一深，这才认真打量了乔昭一眼。
小姑娘身材纤细，形容娇弱，像是一朵含苞欲放却禁不住风吹雨打的白玉兰，格外惹人怜惜，眉梢一粒红痣则让这朵玉兰花娇媚起来。
这是个聪明的小姑娘呢。池灿想。
“妮妮，快回来，别冲撞了贵人！”终于摆脱酒楼伙计的男子冲过来，伸手就拽乔昭。
乔昭身形一晃，像只灵巧的鱼，躲到了池灿身后。
男子抓了个空，又急又怒，解释道：“公子，这是我闺女，因为不听话和我怄气呢，您可别听小孩子胡言乱语——”
“呃，你是他女儿？”池灿侧过身来，笑看着乔昭。
不同于容貌的娇弱，少女语气格外坚定，冷静吐出两个字：“不是。”
“这位大哥，她说不是呢。”池灿看向男子。
男子见情况有些不对，立刻摆出一副忠厚老实的模样，叹气道：“公子有所不知，前两****这闺女被个臭小子哄着私奔，我好容易把人追回来，谁知她和我怄气，就不认我这个爹了，非和别人说我是人贩子，就是为了找那臭小子去！”
男子笃定，只要这话一说出来，旁人就不会多管闲事了。上一次这死丫头逃跑，他用的就是这个理由。
他忍不住看了乔昭一眼，隐含警告。
死丫头，等一会儿收拾你！
乔昭与他平静对视，忽然一笑。

此一时彼一时。
小姑娘黎昭向围观众人求救，虽然人多，实则只要这人给个说得过去的理由，那些人事不关己，也就散了。
而她是向特定的人求救，那人无形中就会多一份责任感，不会一味听从男子的解释。
更何况，他是池灿，若是连这点分辨能力都没有，又怎么和心思曲折的皇亲贵胄们打交道呢？
“小姑娘，你真的和人私奔了？”池灿身子微倾，似笑非笑，分明是在看乔昭笑话。
乔昭一脸认真地问：“大叔，若是您女儿和人私奔了，您会这样嚷嚷出来，丝毫不顾及她的名声脸面吗？”
那当然不会！
池灿下意识想回答，忙死死忍住。
开什么玩笑，他哪来这么大的女儿？一定是听这小姑娘叫大叔听多了。
池灿默默站远一步，眼角余光一扫渐渐围过来的人群，不欲与男子纠缠下去，淡淡道：“二位说的都有道理——”
“公子怎么能听小孩子乱说呢？再说了，这是我们父女的家事——”
池灿对男子一笑。
他生得太好，这一笑真真是让初春都失了颜色：“这位大哥放心，我当然不是多管闲事的人。”
男子暗暗松了一口气，咧出一个笑容，然后就听那俊逸无双的男子慢悠悠道：“所以还是去见官吧，让宝陵知县来断断孰是孰非。”
面对目瞪口呆的男子，他温声安慰道：“我们兄弟三人就把你们送到衙门口，绝对不会多管闲事的。”
“你，你——”遇着这样不按套路出牌的人，男子一时之间竟无言以对。
池灿忽地一皱眉，扭头对蓝衣男子道：“子哲，我记得这宝L县令三年前曾在嘉F县任职吧？”
乔昭趁机悄悄打量蓝衣男子一眼。
祖父有一至交好友，乃当世神医。她八岁那年祖父患病，在那位李神医的建议下，祖父带着祖母与她回嘉丰居住。
前些年，李神医每年都会来嘉丰小住一段日子，替祖父调理身体。她平日广读医书，每当李神医来时便趁机向他请教医术，一晃十来年下来，也算是李神医的半个弟子了，后来祖父的身体便一直靠她调理。

她拖到十八岁才被病重的祖父逼着回了京城，与靖安侯次子成了亲。
新婚丈夫在大婚之日连喜帕都没来得及挑开便奉命出征，不久后祖父亦过世，于是在靖安侯府的那段日子她一直鲜少见外人。眼下这三人，她只认识池灿一人，相识之地还是在嘉丰。

content_en:
Well, calling me "uncle" should put people at ease, right?
Qiao Zhao, who thought he was considerate, spoke quickly and told the whole story: "I am the daughter of Li Xiuzhuan in the capital city. I was abducted here by traffickers during the Flower Festival. Please save me -"
Uncle...
These two words made Chi Can's mouth twitch, and he heard several bursts of laughter. He knew they were two good friends without even thinking about it, and it made him want to reach out and block the little girl's mouth.
He is obviously not much older than this little girl, so why is he an uncle? Just call me brother!
But...if a girl came out in broad daylight and called him big brother, his first reaction would probably be to throw her away, right?
Thinking of this, Chi Can's eyes darkened, and then he took a serious look at Qiao Zhao.
The little girl has a slender figure and a delicate appearance, like a white magnolia that is about to bloom but cannot withstand the wind and rain. She is particularly pitiful. The red mole on the eyebrow makes this magnolia flower more charming.
This is a smart little girl. Chi Can thought.
"Nini, come back quickly, don't hit the noble man!" The man who finally got rid of the restaurant waiter rushed over and stretched out his hand to drag Qiao Zhao.
Qiao Zhao swayed like a nimble fish and hid behind Chi Can.
The man caught the opportunity and explained anxiously and angrily: "Sir, this is my daughter. She is angry with me for being disobedient. Please don't listen to the nonsense of children——"
"Uh, are you his daughter?" Chi Can turned sideways and looked at Qiao Zhao with a smile.
Unlike her delicate appearance, the girl's tone was particularly firm and she calmly said two words: "No."
"Brother, she said no." Chi Can looked at the man.
Seeing that something was wrong, the man immediately put on a loyal and honest look and sighed: "Young master, I don't know. Two days ago, this girl was coaxed by a stinky boy to elope. I finally got her back, but she got angry with me and stopped recognizing me as her father. She told others that I was a human trafficker just to find that stinky boy!"
The man was sure that as soon as he said this, others would stop meddling in his own business. The last time this damn girl ran away, he used this reason.
He couldn't help but glance at Qiao Zhao, implying a warning.
Damn girl, I’ll deal with you later!
Qiao Zhao looked at him calmly and suddenly smiled.
This time, that time.
The little girl Li Zhao asked for help from the onlookers. Although there were many people, in fact, as long as this person gave a justifiable reason, those people would disperse if it had nothing to do with them.
And if she asks for help from a specific person, that person will have an extra sense of responsibility and will not blindly follow the man's explanation.
What's more, he is Chi Can. If he doesn't even have this ability to distinguish, how can he deal with the royal relatives and nobles who have twists and turns?
"Little girl, did you really run away with someone?" Chi Can leaned slightly, half-smiling, obviously looking at Qiao Zhao's joke.
Qiao Zhao asked seriously: "Uncle, if your daughter eloped with someone, would you shout out like this, without caring about her reputation or face?"
Of course not!
Chi Can subconsciously wanted to answer, but was too busy to hold it back.
Are you kidding? Where did he get such a big daughter? She must have heard this little girl call her uncle too many times.
Chi Can stood silently and took a step away. He glanced at the crowd that was gradually gathering around him from the corner of his eye. He didn't want to get entangled with the man anymore and said calmly: "What you two said makes sense——"
"How can you listen to the nonsense of a child? Besides, this is our father and daughter's family matter——"
Chi Can smiled at the man.
He was so good-natured that his smile really made Chuchun lose his color: "Brother, don't worry, I'm certainly not a nosy person."
The man secretly breathed a sigh of relief, grinned, and then listened to the handsome man say slowly: "So it's better to go see the official and let the Baoling County Magistrate decide what is right and what is wrong."
Facing the stunned man, he comforted him in a gentle voice: "The three of us brothers will send you to the yamen gate. You will never meddle in other people's business.". "
"You, you—" When faced with such a person who didn't play by the rules, the man was speechless for a moment.
Chi Can suddenly frowned, turned to the man in blue and said, "Zizhe, I remember that County Magistrate Baol served in Jia F County three years ago, right? "
Qiao Zhao took the opportunity to quietly look at the man in blue.
My grandfather had a close friend who was a miracle doctor. When she was eight years old, her grandfather fell ill. On the advice of Dr. Li, her grandfather took her grandmother back to Jiafeng to live with her.
In the past few years, Divine Doctor Li would come to Jiafeng to stay for a while every year to help his grandfather take care of his health. She read medical books extensively on weekdays, and whenever Divine Doctor Li came, she took the opportunity to ask him for medical advice. After more than ten years, she was considered to be half of Divine Doctor Li's disciples. Later, her grandfather's health was always treated by her.
She waited until she was eighteen years old before being forced by her seriously ill grandfather to return to the capital and marry the second son of Marquis Jing'an.
On their wedding day, her newlywed husband was ordered to go on an expedition before he even had time to pick off the wedding ribbon. His grandfather also passed away not long after, so she rarely saw outsiders during those days in the Jing'an Marquis Mansion. At the moment, among the three of them, she only knows Chi Can, and they met in Jiafeng.
